tokens.iast: parokṣasaṃsthitasyātha dīkṣākarma nigadyate bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati / ityasminmālinīvākye pratiḥ sāṃmukhyāvācakaḥ sāṃmukhyaṃ cāsya śiṣyasya tatkṛpāspadatātmakam / tamārādhyeti vacanaṃ kṛpāhetūpalakṣaṇam tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate / ityasyāyamapi hyartho mālinīvākyasanmaṇeḥ tatkṣaṇāditi nāsyāsti yiyāsādikṣaṇāntaram / kiṃtvevameva karuṇānighnastaṃ gururuddharet gurusevākṣīṇatanordīkṣāmaprāpya pañcatām / gatasyātha svayaṃ mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruceḥ athavādharatantrādidīkṣāsaṃskārabhāginaḥ / prāptasāmayikasyātha parāṃ dīkṣāmavindataḥ ḍimbāhatasya yogeśībhakṣitasyābhicārataḥ / mṛtasya guruṇā yantratantrādinihatasya vā bhraṣṭasvasamayasyātha dīkṣāṃ prāptavato@pyalam / bandhubhāryāsuhṛtputragāḍhābhyarthanayogataḥ svayaṃ tadviṣayotpannakaruṇābalato@pi vā / vijñātatanmukhāyātaśaktipātāṃśadharmaṇaḥ

tokens.iast: gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm / śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte / bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate / gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ adhivāsacarukṣetraṃ śayyāmaṇḍalakalpane / nopayogyatra tacchiṣyasaṃskriyāsvapnadṛṣṭaye mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam / bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat kriyopakaraṇasthānamaṇḍalākṛtimantrataḥ / dhyānayogaikatadbhaktijñānatanmayabhāvataḥ tatpraviṣṭasya kasyāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā / ekādaśaite kathitāḥ saṃnidhānāya hetavaḥ uttarottaramutkṛṣṭāstathā vyāmiśraṇāvaśāt / kriyātibhūyasī puṣpādyuttamaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ekaliṅgādi ca sthānaṃ yatrātmā saṃprasīdati / maṇḍalaṃ tritriśūlābjacakraṃ yanmantramaṇḍale anāhūte@pi dṛṣṭaṃ satsamayitvaprasādhanam / taduktaṃ mālinītantre siddhaṃ samayamaṇḍalam

tokens.iast: yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt / ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ / kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet / tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret / mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate / mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptumīṣṭe / yāvaddhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanamiti mahājālanāmā prayogaḥ etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvamādau pañcādānīyate cetsakalamatha tato@pyadhvamadhyādyatheṣṭam / ākṛṣṭāvuddhṛtau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye@tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ ciravighaṭite senāyugmeyathāmilite punarhayagajanaraṃ svāṃ svāṃ jātiṃ rasādabhidhāvati / karaṇapavanairnāḍīcakraistathaiva samāgatairnijanijarasādekībhāvyaṃ svajālavaśīkṛtaiḥ mahājālasamākṛṣṭo jīvo vijñānaśālinā / svaḥpretatiryaṅnirayāṃstadaivaiṣa vimuñcati tajjñānamantrayogāptaḥ puruṣaścaiṣa kṛtrimam / yogīva sādhyahṛdayāttadā tādātmyamujjhati sthāvarādidaśāścitrāstatsalokasamīpatāḥ / tyajecceti na citraṃ sa evaṃ yaḥ karmaṇāpi vā
